exposure: High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound (HIFU) ablation for uterine fibroids
cohort: The study included 210 women who underwent HIFU treatment for uterine fibroids and subsequently conceived, compared to 510 women who delivered vaginally and 278 who underwent cesarean sections during the same period.
finding: HIFU ablation is a safe and effective fertility-preserving treatment for women with uterine fibroids, demonstrating favorable short-term pregnancy outcomes without increasing overall perinatal risks, though it may influence pregnancy duration and specific complications.
mod_finding: Maternal age and mode of delivery were found to influence the risk of incomplete uterine rupture.
birth_weight: Neonates in the HIFU group had lower birth weights compared to the control groups, though no cases of low birth weight were observed in the HIFU group.
gest_age: Preterm birth was an outcome measure, with fibroid location identified as a predictor of preterm birth.
